subject: Hosted baseline -> Reserved / Private cost scenarios for Baxter Health
messages:
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@baxterhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Baxter Health Procurement <procurement@baxterhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: hosted baseline rates + mapping to Dedicated/Private for procurement

Hi Rafael,

We're kicking off procurement on the LLM piece and need a clear cross-walk from your hosted API baseline pricing to what we should expect if we move to Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. Procurement wants an "all-in" monthly view for budgeting: baseline hosted unit rates, a sample monthly TCO for the Dedicated configuration (committed GPUs + included throughput), and a Private estimate that includes platform fee, license, and an infra/GPU-hour estimate.

Questions to answer would be helpful in a single doc or email:
- Hosted baseline units (prompt token / completion token / embeddings) and how volume tiers change pricing
- Typical committed capacity sizes and the corresponding monthly committed fees for Dedicated
- What changes for Private: one-time license, monthly platform fee, and expected infra/OPEX items we should budget for
- Any required minimums, SLA differences, and typical discounts for 12/24 month commitments

We'd like a short scenario for our likely footprint: ~1M tokens/day (split ~60/40 prompt/completion), 5 concurrent active streams during business hours, and retention of logs for 90 days. Please include attachments or a single PDF that procurement can attach to our PO.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Cole
Head of Procurement, Baxter Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@baxterhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted baseline rates + mapping to Dedicated/Private for procurement

Evan — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a concise cross-walk and two quick scenario tables (see attached PDF). High-level summary below; full numerical examples are in redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf attached.

1) Hosted API (baseline) — per-unit pricing (example, USD):
   - Prompt token: $0.00065 / token
   - Completion token: $0.00125 / token
   - Embeddings (per 1k vectors): $0.30 / 1k
   - No infra commitments; billed per use. Network egress/ingress for heavy volumes may be charged separately depending on region (we include basic usage in hosted totals).

2) Dedicated (Reserved) — how it changes:
   - Pricing model: committed monthly pool (GPU-hours + reserved throughput) + reduced per-token rate on top for overage.
   - Example tier: $48,000 / month for a 4 x A100-equivalent reserved pool (predictable throughput ~200 reqs/s, KV cache included), includes a baseline per-token reduction of ~35% vs hosted.
   - Burst/overage: pay lower per-token overage or short burst capacity at pre-negotiated uplift.
   - Minimum commit: typically 6–12 months for Reserved discounts; 12-month gives best economics.

3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — what changes:
   - One-time platform license & onboarding: typical range $120k–$180k (we can waive part for larger commits).
   - Monthly platform fee (control plane, updates, support): $18k–$25k / month depending on retention and compliance add-ons (audit logs, extended retention).
   - Infra: customer pays GPU infra (hourly) — we provide sizing guidance; rough estimate for a 4 x A100 equivalent cluster: ~$20k–$28k / month in cloud GPU cost (varies by region & discount).
   - Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence and KMS/HSM integration available (can be included as add-on).

Discounting & terms: we typically offer graduated volume discounts (10–30%) and additional pricing flexibility for multi-year commitments. We can provide an "all-in" monthly quote if you confirm target committed tokens or committed GPU pool.

I'll follow up with a dedicated scenario for the 1M tokens/day footprint — quick Q: when you say 5 concurrent streams, are those sustained 5 long-lived sessions (chat-style) or ephemeral API calls that peak to 5 concurrent? That changes capacity sizing.

Attachment: redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf (contains tables and example math).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@baxterhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Baxter Health Procurement <procurement@baxterhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 09:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted baseline rates + mapping to Dedicated/Private for procurement

Rafael — thanks, that helps.

Answers: the 5 concurrent streams are long-lived chat sessions (we expect sustained stateful sessions during business hours, roughly 09:00–17:00 local). For budgeting, please produce an "all-in" monthly TCO for two options:
  A) Hosted with volume discounts applied for 1M tokens/day
  B) Dedicated reserved pool sized to support 5 sustained streams + headroom (with included KV cache & burst).

Procurement also wants any non-recurring fees called out explicitly (onboarding, SOC2 evidence delivery, custom integrations). Ideally put the two scenarios in a single page / single number we can put in the PO, with a line-item breakout. Can you also confirm what we should expect for 90-day log retention costs?

We'll need SOC2 evidence for security — can you attach checklist and estimated delivery timeline?

Thanks — Evan

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Pricing for Baxter Health — discount and onboarding approval (internal)

Rafael/Priyom — quick internal: Evan asked for two all-in monthly numbers. Rafael proposes a 12-mo committed Dedicated at $48k/mo for a 4x A100-equivalent pool with a further 25% off hosted per-token. He also mentioned Private with $150k one-time + $20k/mo platform fee + infra pass-through. Can we do the following concessions to close:

  - Offer 20% off top-line hosted baseline for a 12-month commitment (applied as monthly credit)
  - Waive up to $40k of the Private one-time onboarding/license for a signed 24-mo commitment
  - Include SOC2 evidence & standard audit package at no additional charge (delivery in 2 weeks)

Priyom: margin check — will 20% top-line discount + waived onboarding still keep target ACV and margin for a typical enterprise sale? If not, what's the minimum we can accept?

Cc'ing Priyom for finance/ops and record.

—Laura
VP Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@baxterhealth.com>
Cc: Baxter Health Procurement <procurement@baxterhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 13:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposal: Hosted vs Dedicated (reserved) — all-in monthly scenarios for Baxter Health

Evan — thanks for the clarification. Below are two compact "all-in" monthly scenarios for your finance/procurement team. I've included line-item breakouts and next steps. Attached: baxter_mop_draft.docx (mutual action plan), redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf (calcs). DocuSign link included if you'd like to start signature.

Scenario A — Hosted (volume-discounted, pay-as-you-go):
  - Assumptions: 1M tokens/day (~30M tokens/month), token split 60% prompt / 40% completion, embeddings 50k vectors/month, 90-day log retention.
  - Unit rates (post-volume discount): prompt $0.00052 / token, completion $0.001. Effective blended unit: ~$0.00074 / token.
  - Monthly estimate (tokens + embeddings + retention): $22,200 / month
  - Non-recurring: none
  - SLA: standard hosted SLA; auto-scaling but no reserved throughput guarantees

Scenario B — Dedicated (reserved pool):
  - Assumptions: 4 x A100-equivalent reserved pool sized for 5 sustained chat streams + headroom; includes KV cache and burst policy.
  - Committed monthly fee: $42,000 / month (12-month commit) — includes compute pool and baseline support
  - Per-token overage / additional requests billed at reduced rates (equivalent blended reduction ~35% vs hosted)
  - Monthly estimate (committed + expected overage & logs): $39,500 / month (all-in estimate)
  - Non-recurring: onboarding & setup included in the committed fee for 12-months (we will waive the standard $25k onboarding fee)
  - SLA: 99.9% with performance commitments; dedicated throughput guarantees for peak windows

Private (VPC / on-prem) — indicative (not included in "all-in" above):
  - One-time platform license & onboarding: $150,000 (we can reduce by $40k for 24-mo signed commitment)
  - Monthly platform fee: $20,000 / month (control plane, upgrades, support)
  - Infra: customer pays GPU infra (we estimate $22k–$28k / month for same capacity)
  - Security: SOC2 evidence and audit package included upon order (2-week turnaround for standard artifacts)

Negotiation concessions offered: 20% off hosted baseline for a 12-month commitment OR $42k/mo Dedicated (12-mo) with waived onboarding. Private onboarding reduction as noted.

Next steps:
  - If Procurement wants an exact PO-ready number for Dedicated, we can convert $39.5k estimate into a firm quote and add a short mutually-signed MOP.
  - I'll attach a one-page single-number summary for the PO and a mutual action plan. If that looks good, I'll route a DocuSign for signature.

Attachments: redwood_ratecard_v3.pdf (detailed math), baxter_mop_draft.docx (action plan)

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@baxterhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Baxter Health Procurement <procurement@baxterhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 16:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Hosted vs Dedicated (reserved) — all-in monthly scenarios for Baxter Health

Rafael — this is exactly what we needed, thank you. Procurement likes the single-number options; security will want to review the SOC2 artifacts (please attach checklist) and our infra team wants the Private infra sizing guidance. Two small asks:
  1) Can you move the committed Dedicated price to $40k/mo and we will sign a 24-month term?
  2) Add a one-line in the MOP that Redwood will deliver SOC2 artifacts within 10 business days of signature.

If you can accept (1) and update (2) we can get legal looped and aim to sign next week.

I'll circulate internally and get back with a PO when I have final confirmation.

Best,
Evan
Head of Procurement, Baxter Health
